Forge Initiate's Reference
Item Progression Path
Common
A plain, unenchanted item. No rarity tag. Every build starts here.
Rare
1–3 enchants
Your first enchants land. The foundation every build is built on.
Orb of Subtle Power
Up to 3 random enchants on a common item
Epic
+2–4 enchants
More enchant slots open up. The item starts to feel like yours.
Orb of Humming Power
Adds further enchants on top of a Rare item
Specialised
Signature enchant
One guaranteed custom enchant — the one that defines your build. Requires Rare or above.
Any Specialised Orb
Lightning, Haste, Lifesteal, Soulbound, Mirror and more — plus up to 2 random enchants on top
Shortcut Path
Use a Specialised Orb on a Rare item to skip Epic entirely — your CE lands sooner, but you miss the extra enchant slots from Humming Power. Higher risk, faster payoff.
Orb of the Forge
Epic / Specialised
Creates an exact copy of your item. The copy is stamped ∟ COPIED and cannot be re-forged. The original is untouched — you can forge it again and again.
Modifier Orbs
Transcendence
∞ permanent
One random enchant becomes permanent — immune to every other orb in the game.
Orb of Transcendence
Stamps one enchant as ∞ EnchantName — untouchable forever
Rule
Transcended enchants survive Entropy, Chaos, Regret, Absolution, and Blessing. Even wiping the item back to common won't remove them.
Corruption
ERR:CORRUPTED
Seals the item permanently. Works on common items too — the outcome is always unpredictable.
Orb of Corruption
5% Surge — levels surge upward, bonus enchants added
15% Chaos — max one, decrease one, reroll all
20% Ascension — rarity leap or free transcendence
20% Drain/Purge — weakens or destroys one enchant
10% Transmute — item changes class, incompatibles rerolled
30% Nothing — sealed with no benefit
??? Jackpot — the forge remembers you
Note
On a common item, Surge bootstraps to Rare and Ascension to Rare or Epic. Chaos and Drain fizzle with nothing to work on.
Built Under Pressure
